nest.note: Amabhimu, izinsika, izimbambo nezinsimbi zesitebe ngesamba lengxenye, zisikwa kusuka ezintini zephrofayili nezinto ngazinye: izingcezu ezinde kakhulu kuqala zingena entini yokuqala okulingana nazo, bese ngayinye yentinti ithengwa njengobude obufushane bezitoko obuthatha ukusikwa kwayo. frame.des.aid: Izinhlolo zezingxenye zensimbi ngokwekhodi yedizayini, zezigaba ze-I. Iyisisekelo kuze kubuyekezwe unjiniyela: amandla okuqala kuphela (akukho imiphumela yesibili), akukho ukujikeleka, akukho zingxenye ezincane noma zesigaba 4, akukho oxhumano. Ayithathi indawo yokuhlola kwenjiniyela.

frame.rc.aid: Ukuhlolwa kwekhonkrithi kwamabhimu nezinsika ngokwe-ACI 318-19, ngezisekelo ozisethele ngezansi. Imiphumela ikhona ukuze umhlolisisi ayihlole: ilusizo kuze kubhekwe yiye umuntu. Imikhosi yokuqala, kodwa insika engagxili yenziwa ngomthwalo wayo okhuliswe (6.6.4.5); ukukhuliswa kokugxila (6.6.4.6) akwakhiwe; akukho ukuklama kokujikeleza, akukho ukuklama kwezokuzamazama (isahluko 18), akukho ukuklama kwezibopho (25.7.2), azikho izindonga njengamapuleti okwamanje.
frame.rc.no-sections: Azikho amabhimu, izinsika noma izibopho okwamanje.
frame.rc.assume-note: Isigaba yidrowing onayo (b ngokuya kwe-y yesakhiwo, h ngokuya kwe-z yaso); ukuhlaziywa kusebenzisa iphrofayili edwetshiwe, futhi umehluko oshaya ngaphezu kuka-5 % ebungeni uyabhalwa. Izinduku ziyizinhlamvu emagumbini okumbozwa anikeziwe; ikhonkrithi yesisindo esijwayelekile; izinhlanganisela ziyezika ze-ASCE 7 (ACI 318-19 5.3.1).
frame.rc.err.no-forms: Setha okungenani isigaba esisodwa kuqala (“Setha njengekhonkrithi…”).
frame.rc.err.no-solution: Ukuhlaziywa akukanaxazululo: lungisa okubikwa yikho, bese uhlola futhi.
frame.rc.err.no-combos: Azikho izinhlanganisela zamandla okuhlolelwa kuzo. Cindezela “Yenza izinhlanganisela” kuqala.

frame.rc.title: Ukuhlola kwekhonkrithi
frame.rc.assume-text: Imikhosi yokuqala evela ekuhlaziyweni nge-{stiff}; K = {k}, {sway}; ikhonkrithi yesisindo esijwayelekile (E = 4700 √f’c, ν = 0.2); izinduku njengamaphoyinti; izinhlanganisela ze-ASCE 7. Yokuhlolwa umhlolisisi.
frame.rc.not-built-text: Ukukhuliswa kokugxila (6.6.4.6), ukuklama kokujikeleza, ukuklama kwezokuzamazama (isahluko 18), ukuklama kwezibopho (25.7.2), ukubamba nobude bokuxhumana, ukuhlehla, izindonga.
frame.eq.aid: Amandla angohlangothi alingene (12.8) emaphansini angaphansi njengamacala emithwalo, nokudonsa kwesitezi. Imiphumela ikhona ukuze umhlolisisi ayihlole: ilusizo kuze kubhekwe yiye umuntu. Ngayinye iphansi iba yidayaphrama eqinile ekuhlaziyweni.
frame.eq.none-found: Akutholakalanga zinga elinamabhimu noma izibopho ezimbili noma ngaphezulu. Engeza amaphansi ngesandla.
frame.eq.no-floors: Awukakabi namaphansi. “Thola amaphansi” ithatha amazinga lapho amabhimu ahlangana; bhala isisindo sephansi ngalinye (ingxenye yalo yomthwalo ongaguquki nanoma yisiphi esinye isisindo sokuzamazama).
frame.eq.floors-note: Bhala isisindo sephansi ngalinye, noma ulifunde emacaleni aphezulu: umthwalo oqondile wenodi ngayinye uya ephansini eliphezulu kwayo noma elifanayo, ngakho insika phakathi kwamaphansi amabili inikeza uhhafu wesisindo sayo kwelingayo. Engeza izigaba, 25 % somthwalo wokuphila wokugcina kanye nekhephu lophahla oluthe tshe (ASCE 7-22 12.7.2) ngesici kulawo macala.

frame.break.aid: Ithola okuzoqala ukuvela ohlakeni: inhlanganisela yamandla ebusayo, ilunga elibuthakathaka, isilinganiso somthwalo lapho ilunga lokuqala lifinyelela umkhawulo walo (inhlanganisela ebusayo ekalwe kabusha, ixazululwe futhi ngalo lonke ikhathi), kanye nesixhumanisi esibuthakathaka sezikulufo lapho imodeli ibhala ukuthi izikulufo zithwala ni. Isebenzisa izilungiselelo zokuklama ezingenhla.
frame.break.none-yet: Cindezela inkinobho ukuze uthole. Yenza kuqala izinhlanganisela bese usetha ikhodi yokuklama ngenhla.
frame.break.reserve: Ukukala leyo nhlanganisela, ilunga lokuqala lifinyelela umkhawulo walo ngezikhathi {f} zomthwalo.

frame.break.limits: Ixhume lihlolwa ngokuhlinza nangomthwalo wokuqonda kuphela, kusukela ezimpenjini zelungu, ngokuchasene namandla okuhlinza ezikulufweni (AISC 360-16 J3.6, φ = 0.75). Ukucindezela, ukuhlinza kwebhlokhi, izinsimbi zokushisela kanye nokuphula akuhlolwa. Ukukhululeka kuwukuxazulula kokuqala okuphindwe kabili, akukona ukuhlaziywa kwesibili.

frame.ld.w.warn-gust-changed: G akuyona 0.85: kwakhiwa kuphela isakhiwo esiqinile (amafrikhwensi wemvelo angu-1 Hz noma ngaphezulu); isakhiwo esithambile sidinga isici somoya esivela emgomweni.
frame.ld.w.warn-roof-below-top: Ukuphakama kophahla oyinikeze kungaphansi kwesitezi esiphezulu.
frame.ld.w.note: Inqubo equondile ye-ASCE 7-10 / 7-16, isakhiwo esiqinile (G 0.85), odonga Cp 0.8 ngaphambili no−0.5 ngasemuva; ingcindezi yangaphakathi iyaphelelisa kulo lonke isakhiwo. Umthwalo wesitezi ngasinye yingcindezi phakathi kwesigamu sesitezi ngaphezulu nangaphansi, kulo lonke ububanzi besakhiwo. Ingcindezi yophahla, amacala okujikeleza, izakhiwo ezithambile, i-ASCE 7-22 nengcindezi yokumbozwa akwakhiwe. Ingxenye yomgomo ngamunye enikeza inani ngalinye, namakhasi awaprintayo, itholakala ku-"Imithombo". Isivinini somoya V siyisivinini esiyisisekelo sendawo yakho: sibhale.

frame.ld.src.about: Yonke inani likhonjwe ngamakhasi omphakathi amabili azimele (efundwe ngo-{date}); umgomo uqobo awubanjwe. Lapho amakhasi amabili engavumelani noma kutholakale elilodwa kuphela, inani liyashiywa lidwetshwe ngezansi.

frame.dyn.mass-about: Ubuningi buwubuningi bempahla ngevolumu, kanye nemithwalo ehla yamacala angezansi, ngayinye ngesici sayo (isibonelo icala lokuhlala ku-1 nicala lokuphila ngesabelo osithatha njengobuningi). Isisindo secala ngokwalo asibalwa kabili. Izici ozibhalayo ziyinkinga yakho ukuzikhetha; akukho lutho lapha olungumthetho wekhodi.
frame.dyn.rs.about: Ukuhlaziywa kwesipektiramu yemodi kwemodeli yezakhi eziphelele: izimodi ezitholakele, ngayinye ifundwa kusipektiramu ngesikhathi sayo, ihlanganiswe nge-CQC noma i-SRSS, bese izinkomba zihlanganiswa ndawonye. Inikeza ukunyakaza okuhlanganisiwe ngemodi, ukudonsela kwezitezi, amandla ezitho nokucindezela kwesisekelo. Okuqinile. Isipektiramu siyeyakho: ithebula, noma isimo se-ASCE 7 kusuka ku-SDS, SD1 no-TL. Hhayi ukuhlola ikhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.rs.signs: Amanani ahlanganisiwe awanasimbonzi: yiwona makhulu angaba khona ngayinye, hhayi icala lomthwalo. Amandla ezitho ngamandla asemaphethelweni; ukugoba nokuguqula akuhlanganiswa kulo lonke ubude besitho.
frame.dyn.rs.method: Impendulo yesipektiramu yemodi: {m}, izinkomba {rule}, ukuncipha {xi} % kuyo yonke imodi (isipektiramu ithathwa njengoba inikezwe ngalokho kuncipha).
frame.dyn.rs.limits: Okuqinile. Akukho ukulungisa kobuningi okungekho. Ukudonsela kwezitezi kuqinile futhi akuphindwa ngesici sokukhuliswa kokudonsela, futhi akuhlolwa nomkhawulo. Izimodi ezinezikhathi ezisondelene ziphathwa nge-CQC, noma ngomthetho wamaphesenti angu-ashumi uma ukhethile. Hhayi ukuhlola ikhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.

frame.dyn.sp-use: Sebenzisa amanani ebhokisini lokunyakaza komhlaba (SDS {SDS}, SD1 {SD1})
frame.dyn.sp-rows: Isikhathi (s) nokusheshisa kwesipektiramu, ipheya eyodwa ngomugqa ngamunye
frame.dyn.m-tenpct: Umthetho wamaphesenti angu-ashumi (SRSS, nezimodi ezisondelene zengeziwe)
frame.dyn.th.about: Umlando wesikhathi ongalingani ngaphansi kokusheshisa komhlaba: ukuhlanganiswa kwemodi (ngayinye ixazululwa ngokunembile kurekhodi elinezigaba) noma ukuhlanganiswa okuqondile (i-Newmark average acceleration, ukuncipha kwe-Rayleigh). Imiphumela iyizikhathi zedatha nomaphethelo wangu-ngu-ngayinye. Hhayi ukuhlola ikhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.th.signs: Umaphethelo wamandla ezitho ngamandla amakhulu kakhulu ngayinye yesenzo esiphelele kulo lonke irekhodi, nganoma yiliphi icala.
frame.dyn.th.method: {m}; izinyathelo {n} ezingu-{h} s; i-Newmark average acceleration noma izinyathelo zemodi ezinezigaba ezinembile; iqala ekuphumuleni.
frame.dyn.th.limits: Okulinganayo nokuqinile. Iqala ekuphumuleni ngaphandle kwesimo sokudonsela. Irekhodi lisetshenziswa njengoba linikezwe: akukho ukuhlunga, ukulungisa umgogodla noma ukuskala kusipektiramu. Hhayi ukuhlola ikhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.syn-note: Okokufaka okwenziwe: kwakhiwe ukuhlola imodeli, hhayi irekhodi langempela lokunyakaza komhlaba.
frame.dyn.rec-paste: Noma yiwunamathisele: isikhathi nokusheshisa ngomugqa ngamunye, noma ukusheshisa okukodwa ngomugqa ngamunye nesinyathelo esingenhla
frame.dyn.rec-lost: Lide kakhulu ukuze ligcinwe kanye nemodeli: vula ifayela futhi.

frame.dyn.rec.err.columns: Umugqa ngamunye udinga inombolo eyodwa (ukusheshisa) noma ezimbili (isikhathi, ukusheshisa).
frame.dyn.rec.err.time-order: Izikhathi kufanele zikhule kusuka komugqa kuya komugqa.
frame.dyn.rec.err.need-dt: Irekhodi lekholomu eyodwa lidinga isinyathelo sesikhathi esingenhla.
frame.dyn.dm-modal: Imodi: isilinganiso esifanayo kuyo yonke imodi
frame.dyn.direct-note: Ukuhlanganiswa okuqondile kusebenzisa ukuncipha kwe-Rayleigh: isilinganiso sifakwa emodini yokuqala nasemodini ephezulu esetshenzisiwe. Ukuncipha kwemodi nezilinganiso ezihlukile ngemodi kuyokuhlanganiswa kwemodi.
frame.dyn.ps.about: Ukungaguquki okungenasisekelo: uphahla lusunduzwa ngasohlangothini ngezinyathelo ezincane; ama-hinge apulasitiki akha emaphethelweni ezitho (ehlehlayo, apulasitiki ngokuphelele noma anokuqina, nomthwalo wecala wehlisa umzuzu wepulasitiki). Ukuvumela i-P-delta ngokuzikhethela. Umphumela: ivini lamandla (ukucindezela kwesisekelo ngokumelene nokunyakaza kophahla) nezimo ze-hinge. Hhayi ukuhlola ikhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.ps.stopped.no-convergence: Ukuhlaziywa kumile lapha: izibalo zayeka ukuzinza, ngokuvamile endaweni yokuwa noma ukungazinzi.
frame.dyn.ps.stopped.strength-lost: Ukuhlaziywa kumile lapha: ukucindezela kwesisekelo kwehle kwaphansi kwesihlanu sakho esikhulu kakhulu.
frame.dyn.ps.method: Ama-hinge apulasitiki ahlanganisiwe emaphethelweni ezitho, ukuqina kwensimbi {fy} MPa, ukuqina {r} % kokuqina kwesiphetho, P-delta {pd}; ukulawula ukunyakaza kophahla; imizuzu epulasitiki ephelele kusukela kwesakhiwo se-I esidweshiwe (ama-fillet ashiyiwe).
frame.dyn.ps.limits: Ama-hinge emaphethelweni ezitho kuphela (beka iphoyinti lapho kufanele kwakheke khona ngaphakathi kwesikhala). Izitho ezingenaso isakhiwo se-I zihlala zihlehlayo. Ukuvuna kwe-axial nokugoba kwama-brace akulingiswa. Izindawo nodonga zihlala zihlehlayo. Akukho migomo yokwamukela enikeziwe. Hhayi ukuhlola ikhodi; unjiniyela wakho uyabuyekeza imiphumela.
frame.dyn.fy-note: Iphuzu lensimbi lesakhiwo sokuklama linamandla {fy} MPa; ulibhale phezulu ukuze lisetshenziswe.
frame.dyn.cap-chart: Ivini lamandla: ukucindezela kwesisekelo ngokumelene nokunyakaza kophahla
frame.dyn.nl.about: Lezi zihinge zifanayo ngaphansi kokunyakaza komhlaba kanye nokuncipha kwe-Ibhulokhi ye-Time history (i-Rayleigh ezindleleni ezinikezwe lapho), i-Newmark average acceleration nokuphindaphinda kuka-Newton, kusukela kumbuso wesisindo ongenhla. Kuhamba kancane kumamodeli amakhulu: wagcine lawa ezincane lapha.
frame.dyn.err.no-mass: Akukho okunesisindo. Nikeza impahla ukuminyana, noma thatha ikheyisi lomthwalo njengesisindo ngenhla.
frame.dyn.err.no-dofs: Akukho okukhululekile ukuhamba: wonke amanodi abanjiwe.
frame.dyn.err.no-direction: Zonke izinqondo azisebenzi: nikeza okungenani eyodwa isikali esingaphezu kuka-0.
frame.dyn.err.no-record: Akukho kunyakaza komhlaba okuzosebenza. Khetha okokufaka okulingiswayo noma layisha irekhodi.
frame.dyn.err.too-many-steps: Lokho kungu-{n} izinyathelo zesikhathi: ngaphezu kuka-200,000 (40,000 ngokusebenza okungalingani). Sebenzisa isinyathelo sesikhathi esikhulu.
frame.dyn.err.bad-damping: Isilinganiso sokuncipha kwemodi asiphakathi kuka-0 kuya ku-100 %. Hlola izindlela ze-Rayleigh.
frame.dyn.err.too-big-direct: Ukuhlanganiswa okuqondile kukhawulelwe kumamodeli afika ku-6,000 okungaziwa kanye nenani elincane lezinyathelo; sebenzisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemodi, noma usebenzise ikhompyutha yomsebenzi.
frame.dyn.err.no-hinges: Akukho sitho esingakha ihenji: nikeza izitho ukuma kwe-I (izigaba zensimbi kwi-Ibhulokhi ye-Design).
frame.dyn.err.no-floors: Azikho izitezi ezitholakele: ukusunduza kudinga izinga elinamaxhumanisi okungenani amabili, noma iphansi eliqinile.
frame.dyn.err.no-control: Isitezi esiphezulu alinaxhumanisi elingasunduzwa ngalowo eksisi wodwa.
frame.dyn.err.rec-need-dt: Irekhodi lekholomu eyodwa ludinga isinyathelo sesikhathi.
